So `ofpbuf_init(&ofpacts, 64)` allocates 64 bytes with `xmalloc` and source is `OFPBUF_MALLOC`. When `ofpbuf_put_uninit` needs more than the tailroom, it calls `ofpbuf_resize__` which calls `xrealloc` (since headroom is the same). `xrealloc` may free the old buffer and allocate a new one.

Now let me understand the sizes:
- `OFPACT_ENCAP_SIZE` - the size of `struct ofpact_encap` (fixed part)
- `sizeof(struct ofpact_ed_prop_nsh_md_type)` - size of the MD_TYPE property
- `sizeof(struct ofpact_ed_prop_nsh_tlv)` - size of the TLV property
